_comment: Hand-reviewed habit -> illustration mapping for public/images/habits.
Keyed by habit id from src/data/habit-library.ts. `image` is the file stem
without .png, or null when no suitable illustration exists yet.
`prompt` describes the picture for the ones that need drawing.
Reviewed because automatic matching is wrong in several places: it pairs
vitamin-d3 with the vitamin-c pill, and morning-sunlight / morning-journal /
screen-free-morning all with the meditation picture. Those habits are

lib-magnesium.prompt: a small white supplement capsule lying beside a scatter of pumpkin seeds and a few dark green spinach leaves

lib-omega-3.prompt: a small golden softgel capsule next to two silvery sardines and a lemon wedge

lib-iron.prompt: a small dark red supplement capsule beside a few lentils and a sprig of dark leafy greens

lib-folate.prompt: a small pale yellow tablet beside a halved avocado and a few asparagus spears

lib-b-complex.prompt: a small cluster of three tiny pale capsules beside a wholegrain oat stalk

lib-zinc.prompt: a small white round tablet beside a few pumpkin seeds and a single oyster shell

lib-ashwagandha.prompt: a small brown glass supplement jar with a wooden lid, a few ashwagandha roots and tiny leaves beside it

lib-coq10.prompt: a small amber softgel capsule beside a halved avocado and a few walnuts

lib-iodine.prompt: a small dropper bottle of clear liquid beside a scatter of sea salt crystals

lib-water-2l.prompt: a simple glass water bottle with a soft blue water level, one lemon slice resting beside it

lib-warm-lemon-water.prompt: a warm mug of water with a single lemon slice floating and a curl of steam rising

lib-herbal-tea.prompt: a small teapot pouring into a teacup with a chamomile flower and a sprig of mint beside it

lib-hiit.prompt: a small stopwatch with a lightning bolt beside a pair of trainers, energy implied by a few motion lines

lib-swimming.prompt: a simple pair of swim goggles and a single water ripple

lib-cycling.prompt: a simple bicycle viewed from the side, one wheel slightly forward in motion

lib-dance.prompt: a pair of bare feet mid-step with a few musical notes and motion curves

lib-morning-sunlight.prompt: a low warm sun with soft rays over a windowsill and a small potted plant

lib-grounding.prompt: two bare feet standing on soft grass with a few tiny soil details beneath

lib-screen-free-morning.prompt: a smartphone lying face down and switched off, beside a small cup of tea and a folded book

lib-nature-time.prompt: a small cluster of three slender trees on a gentle hill with a winding path

lib-intentional-rest.prompt: a soft cushion and a folded blanket beside a small crescent moon

lib-cold-exposure.prompt: a small icy plunge tub with a few ice cubes floating and a wisp of cold air curling above

lib-fasting-window.prompt: a simple clock face with a shaded arc marking an overnight fasting window, and a small crescent moon

lib-tongue-scraping.prompt: a slim copper tongue scraper resting beside a small glass of water

lib-oil-pulling.prompt: a small glass bottle of golden oil with a dropper, beside a coconut half

lib-abhyanga.prompt: a small bottle of warm amber massage oil with a few drops falling and a folded towel

lib-nasya.prompt: a tiny dropper bottle of oil with a single drop falling, beside a small brass bowl

lib-nasal-breathing.prompt: a calm abstract face in profile with a gentle curved breath line flowing from the nose

lib-morning-journal.prompt: an open notebook with a pen resting across it and a small cup of coffee beside them

lib-movement-snack.prompt: a simple chair with a pair of legs mid-stand beside it and a small upward arrow

lib-midday-walk.prompt: a winding footpath with a mid-height sun overhead and a small leaf or two drifting

lib-screen-break-20-20-20.prompt: a small open window frame looking out at a distant tiny tree, with a clock face beside it

lib-protein-lunch.prompt: a simple lunch bowl of grains and greens with a boiled egg halved on top

lib-desk-stretch.prompt: a simple wooden desk with a chair pushed back and a small figure reaching both arms overhead

lib-consistent-sleep-time.prompt: a simple alarm clock beside a folded eye mask and a small crescent moon

lib-evening-journal.prompt: an open notebook under a softly glowing lamp with a small crescent moon above

lib-no-food-before-sleep.prompt: a simple plate with a fork resting on it and a small crescent moon above, signalling the kitchen is closed

lib-connect-loved-one.prompt: two simple overlapping speech bubbles each holding a small heart

lib-read-book.prompt: an open book with a small bookmark ribbon and a cup of tea beside it
